upstream_phase2k_e_summary.ke_recommended_next_phase_title: Free Expanded Price/Volume Dataset Build Plan

build_scope.note: Concrete scope a LATER phase (2K-G) would build to. Nothing is built, fetched, or acquired here.
build_scope.target_universe: Broad liquid U.S. equities (S&P 500-style), at least 100 tickers per date.

future_inputs.note: Arguments the future 2K-G build script would accept. The ticker list is a LOCAL / MANUAL file, never a network source.
future_inputs.start_date: earliest date reaching >=8 (ideally 10) years before today

future_outputs.note: Files the future 2K-G build script would write. They are DECLARED here only; this planning phase creates none of them (exists_now must be false for all unless a later phase has already run).

expanded_price_history_csv.role: Longer, broader daily adjusted OHLCV + volume panel.

expanded_scored_csv.role: Feature-ready / scored panel derived from the expanded price history.

data_quality_report_json.role: Result of the data-quality checks with an overall PASS / PASS_WITH_CAVEAT / FAIL status.

data_build_summary_json.role: Reproducible run metadata: date range, ticker count, row count, source, parameters.

survivorship_caveat_json.role: Explicit survivorship-caveat metadata documenting that membership is current-as-of, not point-in-time.

future_script_plan.note: Plan for the future build script. The script itself is NOT created in this phase.
responsibilities: Read the local ticker universe file and the run parameters.
Retrieve free daily adjusted OHLCV + volume per ticker in chunks.
Assemble a single long-format panel keyed on (date, ticker).
Derive dollar_volume and align the benchmark series.
Run the data-quality checks and emit the data-quality report.
Write a reproducible build-summary JSON with explicit run metadata.

ticker_universe_plan.note: The next phase sources tickers from a LOCAL / MANUAL file, never from a network call. A current-membership list is acceptable ONLY with an explicit survivorship caveat.
ticker_universe_plan.membership_caveat: Using a current-membership list back-applied to history is survivorship biased; the active_as_of and survivorship_caveat columns must record this explicitly.

free_data_retrieval_design.note: Design for the future free retrieval. Not executed here; no network call is made by this planning phase.
principles: retry with exponential backoff on transient failures
local on-disk cache keyed by ticker so reruns avoid refetching
idempotent output writes (same inputs reproduce the same files)
explicit run metadata (parameters, timestamps, source label, counts)

data_quality_checks.description: Adjusted-close series is continuous with no unexplained jumps across the join.
No duplicate rows on the (date, ticker) key.
Missing adjusted-close values stay below threshold per ticker.
Missing volume values stay below threshold per ticker.
Daily returns outside a sane bound are flagged for review.
No zero or negative adjusted prices.
Zero / negative volume only where genuinely expected (e.g. halts).
Each ticker covers enough of its live span against the calendar.
Benchmark series spans the full panel date range.
Target labels use only realized future prices, never forward fill.
No claim of point-in-time membership; current-as-of only.
Survivorship-caveat metadata file is present and populated.

future_build_pass_fail_gates.note: Gates the future 2K-G build must satisfy before its output is usable for any retest. Evaluated by the build phase, not here.

gates.rule: All five future output files are written.
Panel spans at least 8 years of daily bars.
Benchmark coverage is complete enough across the panel range.
Duplicate (date, ticker) rate is exactly zero.
Missing adjusted-close / volume rates stay below threshold.
The survivorship-caveat metadata file exists and is populated.
data_quality_report.status is one of PASS / PASS_WITH_CAVEAT / FAIL.

survivorship_caveat_policy.policy: The free build uses current-as-of membership and whatever delisted coverage a free source provides. Any retest run on it must be reported as survivorship-biased, never as a clean point-in-time result. A clean point-in-time build is deferred to a later paid-source decision.

implementation_sequence.action: Phase 2K-G: create the local ticker-universe file with the planned columns and the survivorship caveat recorded.
Phase 2K-G: implement the free build script per this plan (chunked retrieval, retry/backoff, local cache, idempotent writes).
Phase 2K-G: assemble the expanded price-history panel and derive dollar-volume + benchmark alignment.
Phase 2K-G: run the data-quality checks and emit the data-quality report and survivorship-caveat metadata.
Phase 2K-G: evaluate the pass/fail gates; only a passing (or PASS_WITH_CAVEAT) panel is eligible for retesting.
Later: re-run the Phase 2K-B / 2K-C / 2L residual-signal battery on the expanded panel. Still no model candidate and no production integration.

decision.reason: Phase 2K-F only produces the build plan for a free, survivorship-caveated expanded price/volume dataset to later retest avg_dollar_volume_21d. The actual build script, the data fetch, and the dataset are deferred to Phase 2K-G. No data is fetched, no paid data is acquired, no model candidate is created, and no production integration occurs here.

interpretation.narrative: Phase 2K-F turns the Phase 2K-E feasibility result into a concrete, deferred build plan for a free, survivorship-caveated expanded price/volume dataset to later retest avg_dollar_volume_21d. It writes one planning JSON, declares (but does not create) the future build script, the future ticker universe file, and the five future output files, and specifies the data-quality checks and pass/fail gates the later build must satisfy. It builds nothing, fetches nothing, acquires no paid data, trains no model, and creates no model candidate. No production edge is claimed.

recommended_next_phase.title: Free Expanded Price/Volume Dataset Builder
recommended_next_phase.purpose: Implement the local / free expanded dataset builder using this Phase 2K-F plan: assemble the 8-10 year, broader-universe, survivorship-caveated daily adjusted OHLCV panel, run the data-quality checks and pass/fail gates, and emit the build summary and survivorship-caveat metadata. Still no model training, no model candidate, and no production integration.
